directory.name: Modena Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Neighborhood Italian-American spot serving handcrafted pizza and pasta since 2016, with gluten-free and vegan options.
directory.address: 8014 Lake City Way NE, Seattle, WA 98115

directory.name: Hot Slice Pizza
directory.note: Family-owned halal NY-style pizza by the slice, whole pies, calzones and pasta; trades as Hot Slice Pizza (permit filed as Mohi Pizza Dba Hot Slice Pizza).

directory.name: Oskar's Pizza
directory.note: Mobile pizza food truck (no walk-in storefront) run by Piecora's alum Oskar Guerrero; still active per 2026 reviews and food-truck listings.

directory.name: Palermo Pizza & Pasta
directory.note: Classic Capitol Hill Italian spot making dough fresh daily; thin-crust pizzas alongside pasta, calzones and salads.

directory.name: Pizza Paesano
directory.note: Neapolitan pizza pop-up run by Stefano Conte, operating out of Lock & Keel in Ballard (Fri-Sat nights) and Ruby Bar in Greenwood (Mondays); no standalone storefront.

directory.name: Pudge Bros Pizza
directory.note: Family-owned NY-style pizzeria open since 1997, dough made fresh daily in house.

directory.name: Ridge Pizza
directory.note: Family-friendly pizza and bar with arcade games in the former Berserk Game Space; a related but separate second location (Ridge Pizza Northeast) operates in the Ravenna area.

candidateReview.name: Pizza Gallery The
candidateReview.note: Real, long-running (since 1992) pizzeria, but its own site and area listings place it in Burien, WA, not inside Seattle city limits -- the King County permit's 'Seattle, WA 98146' mailing address doesn't reflect the municipal boundary here, so it can't be confirmed to meet the directory's Seattle-location inclusion rule.

candidateReview.name: Pizza Twist
candidateReview.note: Seattle franchisee of Chicago's Pizza With-A-Twist, a national franchise with roughly 150 locations across many states; excluded as a chain.

candidateReview.name: Razzi'S Pizzeria Downtown
candidateReview.note: Downtown/Belltown branch of Razzi's Pizzeria, already on file under its original Greenwood location; permits are issued per-location for the same business.
